testing_and_cli.name: Testing with dotnet test
testing_and_cli.description: Modern guidance for dotnet test with Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode in .NET 10
testing_and_cli.notes: Primary source: VSTest is the default mode of `dotnet test` on .NET 10 SDK; MTP can be selected via `test.runner` in global.json. Newer SDKs may support a DOTNET_TEST_RUNNER environment override; check the installed SDK's runner-selection rules. TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport is a separate legacy interop path.

testing_and_cli.name: Announcing .NET 10

testing_and_cli.name: MTP adoption across test frameworks
testing_and_cli.notes: Framework adoption context only; use the official xUnit and TUnit documentation below for current runner support. VSTest remains the default dotnet-test mode on .NET 10.

testing_and_cli.name: NUKE issue #1584 — MTP support tracker
testing_and_cli.notes: Opened Dec 22 2025; issue documents VSTest-oriented NUKE test helpers and requests MTP support. Check the issue and installed NUKE helper API before using the workaround in test-platform-modes-and-cli.md.

testing_and_cli.name: xUnit.net v3 Microsoft Testing Platform guide
testing_and_cli.notes: xUnit v3 supports both MTP and VSTest; VSTest uses xunit.runner.visualstudio and Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk.

testing_and_cli.name: TUnit troubleshooting and FAQ
testing_and_cli.notes: TUnit uses MTP rather than VSTest.
